name: Cycle continuously for fifteen minutes
short_description: Cycle continuously for fifteen minutes once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can cycle continuously for fifteen minutes in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Cycle continuously for fifteen minutes means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Cycle continuously for fifteen minutes in a fresh real-life scenario.
